import subprocess
d=open('build/verify-human.ppm','rb').read()
parts=d.split(b'\n',3)
assert parts[1]==b'800 600',parts[1]
px=parts[3]
coverage=sum(1 for i in range(0,len(px),3) if px[i+1]>60 or px[i]>60)
assert coverage>20000,coverage
out=subprocess.run(['build/verify/aurora-mesh.exe','--bench','6','--no-gpu'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout
line=[l for l in out.splitlines() if l.startswith('software:')][0]
ms=float(line.split()[1])
assert ms<40.0,ms
gpu=subprocess.run(['build/verify/aurora-mesh.exe','--render','build/gpu-check.ppm','--gpu','--width','800','--height','600'],capture_output=True,text=True)
soft_px=parts[3]
gpu_px=open('build/gpu-check.ppm','rb').read().split(b'\n',3)[3]
assert len(gpu_px)==len(soft_px),(len(gpu_px),len(soft_px))
if 'GPU frame was empty' in gpu.stderr:
    assert gpu_px==soft_px,'the fallback must reproduce the software frame exactly'
    print('coverage',coverage,'software ms/frame',ms,'parity skipped: device rasterizes nothing, fallback verified')
else:
    mean=sum(abs(a-b) for a,b in zip(gpu_px[::7],soft_px[::7]))/len(soft_px[::7])
    assert mean<8.0,mean
    print('coverage',coverage,'software ms/frame',ms,'parity mean channel difference',round(mean,2))
